title: Irish Potato Dumplings
description: A hearty side dish made with wholesome Irish potatoes, perfect for accompanying traditional Irish meals. These potato dumplings are boiled to perfection.
instructions: Boil a large pot of salted water.
Grate the Irish potatoes into a large bowl.
Add flour to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces.
Shape each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly.
Dust the potato dumplings with flour.
Add the dumplings to the boiling water and cook for 15-20 minutes.
Remove the dumplings with a slotted spoon.
Serve hot with a pat of melted butter.
